notes:
Fixes corrupted UI text. ui/web/index.html had been round-tripped through cp1252 (UTF-8 bytes decoded as Windows-1252 and re-saved as UTF-8), which turned every em dash, ellipsis, curly apostrophe and the multiplication sign in the aquarium presets into mojibake - the dropdown read 'Standard 1680A-900' instead of '1680x900', and the Hyperion/Process/Luau readouts showed garbage instead of an em dash. The bytes were still valid UTF-8, so nothing downstream noticed.

Adds tools/check_encoding.py and wires it into packaging: the build now fails if any shipped text asset is not clean UTF-8 or contains cp1252 artifact sequences, so this class of corruption cannot reach a release again.

Shell rebuilt so the repaired HTML is embedded; core and Lua bundle unchanged from 1.1.6.
